C05 and C08 share the general form of short Eisenhower letters supporting pending legislation, but their overlap is substantially more generic.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There has long been a need for more adequate facilities in the Nation's capital for the presentation of the performing arts.","parent_excerpt":"the long-felt need for a national civic auditorium in the District of Columbia","explanation":"Both describe the same longstanding deficiency in performing-arts or auditorium facilities in Washington."},{"child_excerpt":"An auditorium and other facilities such as are provided for in pending legislation","parent_excerpt":"the further steps necessary to provide in our capital city a civic auditorium and cultural center","explanation":"The child closely adapts C24's paired auditorium-and-cultural-center formulation into a description of the pending proposal."},{"child_excerpt":"would be a center of which the entire Nation could be proud","parent_excerpt":"a civic auditorium and cultural center worthy of our great nation","explanation":"This is a distinctive parallel national-pride formulation attached to the same proposed facility."}]}
